dispatches.title: Welcome to the practice
dispatches.body:
This is where Marcus reaches you: word when a new letter arrives in your first week, the occasional notice, nothing more.

Everything here is meant to be seen once, then it clears. No noise. Reminders live in your notifications, and only if you ask for them.

The practice is simple. Show up, set your intention, examine your day. Begin when you are ready.
